attributes.additional_details: Domestic abuse is a devastating issue that affects individuals regardless of gender, sexuality, background, or identity. Recognizing the experiences of male victims is essential to building an inclusive support system and removing barriers to reporting.
attributes.background: Make domestic abuse more fairer, recognise that men can be abused by women just the same as the other way around

rejection.details:
Petitions must seek specific action for the UK Government or Parliament.

You could start a new petition calling for the Government to fund an awareness campaign on this topic, if this is something you would like to see.
